:::{#def-superset}
#### Superset

A set $B$ is a **superset** of a set $A$,
written $B \supseteq A$,
if every element of $A$ is an element of $B$.

:::

::: notes
So $B \supseteq A$ means the same thing as $A \subseteq B$
([subset](#def-subset)).
For example, $\set{1, 2, 3} \supseteq \set{1, 3}$.
:::
